records.name: race-card
records.source: composed from 21st parts (no single 21st race component found): 29368, 6955, 12336
records.port: apps/mobile/src/chat/race-card.tsx: RaceCard (one race_routes part) + RaceRows (takes a RouteRace; the Routes lane's RouteList can replace it)
records.deviations: Rows keep the order venues were asked (no resort jump on a phone); only the Best badge moves. 29368's change pulse became a one-shot wash on the row whose quote lands, and its numeric morph a count-up from zero (NumberTicker). Status is a word under the venue, never colour alone. The venue's real mark (packages/identity) breathes while asked, lights when quoted, fades when it cannot quote.

records.name: streaming-data-rows
records.author: rmahammad
records.port: RaceRows in apps/mobile/src/chat/race-card.tsx (native twin, no table: a list of rows)
records.deviations: No sorting headers, row actions or mobile/table switch: one row per venue, stacked; loading/empty/error live on RaceCard (skeleton before the first snapshot, 'no venue answered' with Try again, 'quoting directly').

records.name: badge-tag
records.author: prebuiltui
records.port: the Best pill in RaceRow (ui-native Badge, primary variant), zooming in on the new leader and fading from the old

records.name: text-shimmer
records.author: serafimcloud
records.deviations: The web original clips a moving gradient to the glyphs; React Native has no text clip on every platform (Skia text would need fonts on the web export), so the highlight travels word by word (opacity wave). Words, never letters, so joined scripts keep their shaping. Reduced motion: still text.
